name: Obfuscated and Unsigned .NET Assembly Loaded
description: Detects the .NET runtime loading an assembly that has a name resembling a random string and lacks a Strong Name signature (PublicKeyToken=null). This is not characteristic of a legitimate, compiled library but is a typical hallmark of a malicious .NET payload that is dynamically generated and executed in memory by an attacker.

action.description: An unsigned assembly with a suspicious, random-looking name was loaded.

operational_usage: This detection is a very strong indicator that a memory-based .NET malware is executing. Immediately isolate the affected process and its parent, and perform a memory dump for forensic analysis. Block any associated network connections and hunt across the environment for other systems exhibiting the same assembly name or pattern.
false_positive: False positives are highly unlikely. While some in-house development tools or third-party licensing libraries might show similar patterns, the combination of a random-string name and the absence of a signature is extremely rare. Therefore, every alert should be treated as a high-priority incident.
